rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unfortunate or difficult situation.

example.english: After losing my job, my whole family ended up in a predicament.
example.traditional: 失業之後，我哋一家人陷入困境。
example.jyutping: sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 haam6 jap6 kwan3 ging2

rows.note: Use this when focusing on someone's circumstances or position rather than the difficulty itself.

example.english: Put yourself in his predicament and you will see how hard it is to make a decision.
example.traditional: 你試吓諗下自己處於佢嗰種處境，真係好難做決定。
example.jyutping: nei5 si3 haa5 nam2 haa5 zi6 gei2 cyu2 jyu1 keoi5 go2 zung2 cyu2 ging2 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 zou6 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this colloquially when the predicament is described as trouble or an immediate problem.

example.english: The car has broken down in the middle of nowhere, and we are really in a predicament now.
example.traditional: 部車喺荒山野嶺死火，我哋今次真係麻煩喇。
example.jyutping: bou6 ce1 hai2 fong1 saan1 je5 leng5 sei2 fo2 ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 maa4 faan4 laa3
